mu_name_from: MODEL_CAPE_OF_LORD = MODEL_HELPER+30, AccessModel(..., L"Data\\Item\\", L"DarkLordRobe") (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1016, its sheet :1405); ITEM_CAPE_OF_LORD = ITEM_HELPER + 30 (_enum.h:2729), group 13 number 30; named as OpenMU's VersionSeasonSix/Items/Wings.cs:88.
why_this_one: The Dark Lord's wing: his back in slot 7, made in the Chaos Machine from a 1st wing, a Jewel of Chaos and the Crest of Monarch (docs/plans/dark-lord-cape.md, the user's "Decided" 2026-10-25).
profile_note: MU's DarkLordRobe.bmd is the bag and ground model alone, a 16-triangle folded cloth: RenderLinkObject never draws it on the body (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7006-7012). The worn cape is DarkLordCape (content/items/armor), a mesh on his own bones.
worn_note: MuMain wears it as cloth #2 of the Dark Lord's cloth set, a 10x10 sheet pinned to bone 19 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:9691-9765; dark-lord-cape.md section 4). Ours, the user's "rigged cape first": DarkLordCape, skinned to his spine, hips and thighs, drawn while this row is worn (game/figures.cpp Figures::dress). His shoulder tails and skirt as cloth are later.
ground_note: MuMain turns it (-90, 0, 0) in the bag (ZzzInventory.cpp:8218-8221); ours frames every bag model by its bounds.
effects_note: No glow, sprite, particle or light on the Cape of Lord in MuMain, and its plus shows nothing: the wing render forces level 0 and the worn cape is cloth, not a model (dark-lord-cape.md section 4).

stats.note: The item's own row, OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser; what it does is sim's (sim::capeOfLord): level 180 + 4 a plus, defence 2 a plus, damage x(120 + 2 a plus)%, absorb 10 + 2 a plus, 3 Life a blow, the option damage always, the extras one of four with Command +10 + 5 a plus its alone.
stats.call: this.CreateWing(30, 2, 3, "Cape of Lord", 180, 15, 200, 180, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, this.BuildOptions((0b00, OptionType.PhysDamage)), 20, 10, this._damageIncreaseByLevelTable, this.CreateCapeOptions()); capeOfLord.Group = 13

sheet_from: Data/Item/DarkLordRobe.OZT (128x256 with alpha, 33% cut away): a navy velvet trapezoid edged in gold chain, a gold crest and chain down its middle. The same bytes as Data/Player/DarklordRobe.OZT, the worn cloth's sheet (BITMAP_ROBE+7, ZzzOpenData.cpp:444). Decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
sheet_materials_from: Velvet with gold embroidery, judged from the sheet.
cutout_from: DarkLordRobe.OZT's alpha is the cape's outline; the cloth is drawn MASK_ALPHA (alpha-tested) in MuMain (PhysicsManager.cpp RenderFace).
cutout_alpha_from: Declared: DarkLordRobe.OZT's alpha is the cape's outline (decode_texture: 33% cut away). Without it cutout keys on brightness and the navy velvet, near-black, keyed out, leaving only the gold (2026-10-26).
